title: Synapse Band raw research frame v1
description: GENERATED by tools/generate_contracts.py from config/hardware.yaml (raw_frame): do not edit. One notification of the research service carries one frame: a 12-byte header and sample_count values, little-endian two's complement, channel-minor.
rules: sample_count counts VALUES (channel-minor), not multi-channel samples: a 3-channel stream with sample_count 6 carries 2 samples. Channels per stream: gatt_v2.json stream_metadata.
timestamp_us is the low 32 bits of the device microsecond clock at the FIRST sample of the frame; sample i is at timestamp_us + i * 1e6 / rate_hz.
flags bit ts_epoch_wrapped: this frame's timestamp is lower than the previous transmitted frame of the SAME stream, i.e. the 32-bit counter wrapped in between: add 2^32 to the stream's epoch.

sequence is per stream, uint16, advanced only when the band's stack ACCEPTS the frame: a refused attempt is retried with the same number and its samples stay queued, so a hole means a frame lost after the stack took it. Samples the band had to discard travel in `dropped`. A repeat or an older value is not a gap, and its samples are not appended: a step back of up to 64 frames is out of order, a longer one is a restart of the band (its clock restarts too).
dropped: samples lost for this stream since the previous transmitted frame, saturating at dropped_max (0 = no loss).
A frame with an unknown version, stream id or sample format is counted as a loss and never interpreted.
